hooks.name: to record the pending question on the Q&A cadence

action.command: if [ -f config/.question_pending ]; then if [ -f senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_qa_event.py ]; then python3 senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_qa_event.py record-question; fi; fi

hooks.name: to record the bootcamper's answer on the Q&A cadence

action.command: if [ -f senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_qa_event.py ]; then python3 senzing-bootcamp/scripts/log_qa_event.py record-answer; fi
